verdict: GENUINE VARIANCE, MECHANISTICALLY EXPLAINED -- not a bug, not simple noise
best_hypothesis: [INFERRED, medium-high confidence] FiLM-generator extrapolation instability: PA physiology vector lies well outside the convex hull of its LOHO training pair (EC+BS), the worst case of any host/pair combination tested. The FiLM generator (small MLP) receives no training signal constraining its output there, so its near-linear extrapolation can go sign-preserving or sign-inverting depending on random seed -- producing the observed bimodal fold pattern. Consistent with (a) unfreezing conv4 rescuing every affected fold, (b) PAs independently-established (Gate 1.5) status as the most source-sensitive/statistically unusual host in this feature space, (c) EC (smallest extrapolation) showing the mildest instability of the 3 primary hosts.
not_fully_resolved: The exact internal FiLM-generator mechanism (why THIS specific inversion direction per fold) was not traced at the individual-weight level -- would require additional controlled experiments (multi-seed sweeps, stronger FiLM-generator regularization) outside this ~1hr bounded investigation.
retraining_implication: Genomic-variant results are NOT affected -- verdict is genuine variance specific to physiology features extrapolation, not a bug. No additional retraining triggered by this task beyond what Task 1 (growth-rate vector fix) already requires.
